"""Ensure S18_SECRET_SALT exists before test modules are collected.

pytest imports conftest.py before collecting test files, so defining a
default here guarantees that both tests/test_signer.py (which hashes the
variable at module scope) and signer.signature() observe the same value,
even when the variable is missing from the surrounding environment.
setdefault is used so an externally provided salt always wins.
"""

import os

os.environ.setdefault("S18_SECRET_SALT", "s18-default-salt")
